text: Someone plugs a home router into the network backwards, so its LAN port faces the corporate network. What happens?
choices: Nothing — the port will not link
Clients randomly receive addresses from the wrong subnet with the wrong gateway, depending on which server replied first
The switch shuts the port down automatically
explanation: This is one of the purest examples of an intermittent, non-reproducible fault with a completely deterministic cause. DHCP snooping — designating trusted ports and dropping server messages from all others — is the mitigation.
